**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bind output metadata to the frozen input package**

The independent validator only checks the collection's schema/scope/execution baseline here and never compares `generation_id`, `input_manifest_sha256`, or `input_package_content_sha256` (nor the run receipt's corresponding input hashes) to the frozen commitment. A self-rehashed collection/receipt can therefore name arbitrary input package hashes while still passing as long as its observations match the supplied manifest, which breaks the custody binding those fields are supposed to prove.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Allow row-leading subpart markers in stem split**

When a PDF text row starts with a subpart marker such as `(i)`, this regex does not match because it requires whitespace before the marker. The stem-building loop then keeps appending subpart rows to `question_stem_source_transcription`; this already affects committed E1 observations like `qrow_9709_m16_qp_32_q09`, where the stem includes the `(i)` and `(ii)` answer prompts instead of stopping at the first subpart.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Stop final-question transcription at the real question end**

When `following_question_label` is null for the last question, this branch performs no end-boundary trimming and copies every row in `page_chain`. For final questions whose A-01 boundary runs to document end, the generated E1 output already includes trailing additional/blank/copyright pages (for example `qrow_9709_m25_qp_32_q11`) in `question_source_transcription`, corrupting the bounded question evidence and downstream formula/visual signals.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Match formula functions as whole tokens**

This regex matches `sin`, `cos`, `tan`, `log`, and `ln` anywhere inside words, so ordinary prose like `constant` is classified as formula evidence with token `tan`.
